name: Metkorp Equipments Pvt Ltd.
india_angle: Metkorp Equipments Pvt Ltd. is based in Delhi and is a leading manufacturer of metallurgical equipment in India.
summary: Metkorp Equipments Pvt Ltd. specializes in manufacturing and supplying metallurgical and material testing equipment. Their products are used for examining material microstructures, which can be relevant in semiconductor packaging and testing processes.
